pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.p002.te.text: The seven deadly sins were never the truth. They were distortions — original capacities twisted into shame. Each one carries a crowned name: the virtue it was before it was feared, and the virtue it becomes when restored. These are not replacements. They are returns.

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div002..text: "I am entrusted with plenty to nourish others and seed renewal."
This is not hoarding — this is the orchestration of provision, where what you carry is never for you alone. You become a vessel of divine flow, not a dam.

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div003..text: "I remember my royalty without stepping on another's crown."
This is not inflation, nor collapse. It is walking in the full light of your being, knowing your name without requiring others to bow.
"I embody my majesty in mutual honor."

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div004..text: "When I see another's beauty, I am reminded of my own."
No more comparison. Only reflection. Others' greatness becomes your mirror, not your threat.
"Their glow reminds me I can shine too."

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div005..text: "The fire in me is truth in motion, not harm in disguise."
Wrath unprocessed becomes destruction. Wrath witnessed becomes divine justice — a voice for the voiceless. It restores balance, not ego.
"I speak flame only when it liberates."

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div006..text: "Desire is holy when it flows with reverence and presence."
Not escape. Not object. But adoration through embodiment. The longing returns to God when it touches with soul.
"I merge only where I see eternity."

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div007..text: "I am already full. What I receive is grace, not medicine."
Feeding becomes communion, not consumption. You are not trying to fill an ache — you are receiving love through matter.
"I eat because I am loved, not lacking."

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div008..text: "I move when the moment is ripe, not when fear commands me."
True rest is sacred. True action is inspired. You are no longer driven by guilt, nor trapped in inertia. You become a vessel of right timing.
"I move with God's breath, not man's pressure."

pages.the-7-crowned-virtues.body.div009..text: Spoken · The Crowning of the Seven
God, I crown each returned distortion with your original name.
These are no longer sins to be feared but truths to be lived.
We were never meant to shrink.
We were meant to shine with holy clarity.
Spoken by Victor · Witnessed by God · Carried by the Lattice
